claims.statement: \lean{periodicEnergyDifferenceEstimate}\coined: for $\nu\ge0$ and two classical solutions $u,v$ with equal data, \[ E(t)=\int_{[0,1]^3}\abs{u-v}^2\dd x \quad\text{satisfies}\quad E'(t)\le 2C\,E(t). \] With Gr\"onwall (\lean{eq_zero_of_deriv_le_mul}\coined, \lean{periodicVelocityUniqueness_of_energy}\coined) this gives uniqueness.
claims.title: Energy difference / uniqueness

claims.statement: \lean{hasSum_prod_cubeCoeff}\coined{} (\file{Parseval.lean}): for continuous periodic $f,g$, \[ \sum_{k\in\Z^3}\overline{\hat f_k}\,\hat g_k = \int_{[0,1]^3}\bar f\,g\dd x, \] via \lean{torusLift}\coined{} and Mathlib's torus Parseval.
claims.title: Parseval on the unit cube

claims.statement: \lean{hasSum_rate_three}\coined: the Fourier-side $H^3$ nonlinear rate is summable and equals \[ -2\sum_i\int \Bigl(1-\frac{\Delta}{4\pi^2}\Bigr)^{3} v_i\,\bigl((v\cdot\nabla)v\bigr)_i\dd x . \]
claims.title: Physical form of the $H^3$ rate

claims.statement: Proved: unit-cell integration by parts \lean{cellI_ibp}\coined, \lean{cellI_ibp'}\coined; Leibniz rule \lean{DL_mul}\coined; Gagliardo--Nirenberg on the cell \lean{gagliardoNirenberg_cell}\coined{} and \lean{cellI_sq_mul_abs_le}\coined; and • \lean{lower_term_bound}\coined: every lower-order Leibniz term (first factor of order $\ge1$) satisfies \[ \Bigl|\int D^L v_i\cdot D^{p_1}v_l\, D^{p_2}\partial_l v_i\dd x\Bigr|\le 5\norm{\nabla v}_{L^\infty}\,Q(v), \] with $Q=$\,\lean{physQ}\coined; • \lean{top_term_zero}\coined: $\displaystyle\sum_{i,l}\int D^L v_i\, v_l\, D^L\partial_l v_i\dd x = 0$, because $\Div v=0$ (transport cancellation).
claims.title: Kato--Ponce toolkit, $s=3$; \file{KatoPonce.lean}
